rules.title: Do not overclaim Final Cut or Motion compatibility
rules.body: Separate repository-test evidence from real-app evidence. Automated XML/unit/MCP tests may prove code behavior, but never describe Final Cut Pro or Motion compatibility as verified until the relevant import/export or template round trip has been observed on an actual Mac.

rules.title: Preserve user media and edit projects by default
rules.body: Treat user media, libraries, projects, templates, and exports as valuable data. Default to non-destructive copies and unique output paths. Require an explicit overwrite/delete instruction before replacing existing artifacts.

rules.title: Never interpolate user paths into shell strings
rules.body: When invoking local commands, use executable-plus-argument-array APIs. Never concatenate a user-controlled file path into a shell command string.

rules.title: MCP changes need protocol verification
rules.body: Any MCP tool or transport change must preserve a passing stdio initialization, tools/list, and at least one relevant tools/call path before it is considered complete.

rules.title: Gate Motion mutation behind real fixtures
rules.body: Do not introduce generic Motion project mutation from guessed XML structure. First capture representative real templates and a successful Motion/Final Cut round trip, then make the mutation schema-specific and tested.
